items.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
items.summary: Alpenglow is running on both public test networks, giving application teams a place to check their software before the live blockchain switches.

items.title: XRP Ledger’s Batch upgrade slips to Oct. 9 after validator support resets
items.summary: The feature would let users bundle up to eight transactions, including asset-and-payment transfers, but a brief drop below the network’s 80% support threshold restarted its two-week activation clock.

items.title: SlowMist has yet to confirm crypto theft from iPhone Safari attack
items.summary: The analyzed Safari sample targets iOS 18.4–18.6.2 using previously patched flaws, while its effectiveness on iOS 26.5 remains unverified.

items.title: Tether confirms minimal EQIBank exposure following $89M US asset seizure
items.summary: While Tether's stated ceiling places its maximum exposure under $64 million, the incident underscores lingering counterparty risks in fiat gateway networks.

items.title: Magic Eden scare puts 3,832 NFTs in whitehat protective custody
items.summary: Yuga Labs’ 0xQuit said the NFTs are safe and will be returned once the risk passes, while holders were urged to revoke NFT permissions.

items.title: Fed proposes new capital, redemption rules for stablecoin issuers
items.summary: The Fed’s proposal would set capital requirements, a two-day redemption window and new reserve disclosures as regulators implement the GENIUS Act.

items.title: Bitcoin price steadies, ONDO rallies as US Treasury yields hit 2007 highs
items.summary: US Treasury yields hit a 19-year high on Thursday, pressuring risk assets as Bitcoin held near $84,000 and ONDO became top performer among altcoins.

items.title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
items.summary: Researchers have mapped out private bitcoin-denominated transfers that run alongside Bitcoin, but the system still lacks a finished way to lock up real BTC and release it again.

items.title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to leave post on Oct. 2
items.summary: Peirce, known as “Crypto Mom,” served on the SEC for about eight years, including as director of the Crypto Task Force.

items.title: CFTC sues Cash FX, alleges $950M crypto-linked forex scheme
items.summary: The CFTC claimed that Cash FX engaged in minimal forex trading and misappropriated most of the participant funds.

items.title: Don't let TEEs break your MPC

items.title: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
items.summary: The long-anticipated exit of the commissioner sometimes known as Crypto Mom is Oct. 2, announced as the agency was sending out its latest crypto work.

items.title: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations
items.summary: A Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals panel ruled that prediction markets' sports-related events contracts are not swaps, and therefore aren't subject to federal regulatory oversight.

items.title: Blockchain Association sees leadership shift shortly after crypto Clarity Act fizzles
items.summary: The trade group will be run again by its original CEO, Kristin Smith, when Summer Mersinger leaves at the end of a long congressional tussle.

items.title: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist
items.summary: The stablecoin issuer blacklisted a wallet holding about $318,000 in USDT and USDC. Most of the stolen funds sit in ether, which can't be frozen.

items.title: Tokenization is moving faster than Washington
items.summary: Regulatory clarity is not simply a legal or political issue, argues former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo. It is an economic one.

items.title: Strategy proposes daily dividends to bring STRC back toward $100
items.summary: STRC has remained below $100 since May, despite a 12% dividend rate and roughly $1 billion in preferred share buybacks.

items.title: Bond volatility surges while bitcoin and Wall Street stay calm
items.summary: Bond volatility is at its highest since March, while the bitcoin VIX, BVIV and Wall Street's VIX remain near its yearly low.

items.title: Altcoins rally across the board as bitcoin consolidates near $84,000
items.summary: Quant jumped 39% over 24 hours and 93 of 100 CoinDesk 100 constituents rose, with the altcoin season index at its highest in more than three months.
